author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We examine some unique film production ephemera from pop culture past, including a few production binders for Tim Burton's unmade Superman Lives film. Through budget breakdowns, script notes, and early storyboards, we're able to piece together more of the story and scope of what this Nicolas Cage Superman movie was to be. Plus, a treasure trove of candid photos from the making of both Return of the Jedi and the original Ghostbusters!

Learn more about these documents and photos, and see more details at: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/496

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
Additional media courtesy of Propstore
